items.name: Minnesota Meetup III Wednesday 2024
items.information: This competition is a series competition with: * [Minnesota Meetup III Tuesday 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaMeetupIIITuesday2024) * [Minnesota Meetup III Thursday 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaMeetupIIIThursday2024) ***You may only compete in one of these competitions.*** At this competition, only the top three newcomers in each event will receive awards. [Please click here for more info about series competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaMeetupIIITuesday2024#33917-series-competitions-faq) | | | -------- | This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcDAwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9d340df17a1aec4ba42677c10d4db2f31757ffba/image.png) We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
